item.description:
The three endpoints contained in this folder are required to authenticate and receive a bearer token to be used when making calls to the API.  
  
This authentication process utilizes OAuth 2 with PKCE.

The calls in this folder provide an example of sending eShipping a shipment, then getting rate quotes and finalizing the shipment.\\n\\nIf the desired process is to send eShipping incomplete shipments and then rate shop and finalize the shipments via the TMS, all that is needed is the first request (POST Shipment - Incomplete/Proposed)

.

item.name: Quick Quote
item.description:
The Quick Quote endpoints can be used to determine rates without setting up a shipment.  
Version 1 of quick quote rates are based on weight and zip codes.  
Version 2 of quick quote rates utilize the dimensions to provide more accurate rates.  
  
We recommend using Version 2
